findings.problem: The example uses ver only in the infinitive, and it means visiting someone rather than seeing with your eyes.
findings.fix: example.es: No veo bien sin mis lentes. / example.en: I can't see well without my glasses.

back.example: I want to see my mother today.

note: The trick's sound link is loose, because ver sounds more like "bear" than "where", but it says nothing false.
